## Download

**[CareLink-Menubar.dmg](https://github.com/tixastronauta/carelink-menubar/releases/latest/download/CareLink-Menubar.dmg)**
for macOS 14 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel).

## Install in three steps

1. Open the downloaded `CareLink-Menubar.dmg` and drag **CareLink Menubar** onto **Applications**.
2. Open the app from Applications. macOS shows a message saying it cannot verify the app. This is
   expected, because this free, open-source build is not notarized by Apple. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to **Security**, click **Open Anyway**
   next to CareLink Menubar and confirm. You only need to do this once for each new version.

The app then appears in your menu bar. Accept the consent screen and sign in on the official
CareLink page.

**Updates:** from 0.3.3 on, the app checks for new versions once a day and shows a notice in its
panel; one click installs the update. Coming from 0.3.2 or earlier? Install this version from the
DMG once, and later versions will reach you automatically.

> CareLink Menubar is unofficial and read-only. It never controls your pump and does not replace
> your pump, sensor, the MiniMed app or their alarms. Always confirm values in the official app.

See the [README](https://github.com/tixastronauta/carelink-menubar#readme) and the
[user guide](https://github.com/tixastronauta/carelink-menubar/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) for details.
